announce.repliedLong: Companion replied. Use heading navigation to read it.
announce.slow: Still working on it. You can keep reading or stop it.
announce.stalled: The reply may not finish. You can ask again.
announce.offline: Connection lost. The reply continues when you're back online.
announce.stopFailed: Couldn't stop the reply. Try again, or delete the question.
announce.ended: Couldn't reply. You can ask again.
announce.cancelled: Question cancelled. Your text is back in the box.
announce.notSent: This question couldn't be sent. Edit it and try again.
announce.sendFailed: Couldn't send. Your text is back in the box.
announce.unconfirmed: We couldn't confirm your message was saved. Check the conversation before sending it again.
